module.name: DOMAINTAINS
module.description: PBX-side module for FreePBX 16 and 17, providing SIP trunking and numbering integration with DOMAINTAINS SBCs via FreePBX UK's my-connect.
module.changelog: *0.1.0* Initial development scaffold. Adds FreePBX 16/17 module metadata, a minimal DOMAINTAINS GUI, and the fwconsole domaintains status command. No provisioning actions are implemented yet.
